title: The Same Wrong Number
skyStory: The moon is sixty-nine percent lit and has slid into Scorpio, the sign of secrets, intensity and very dramatic eye contact. She is wearing a dark cloak and whispering into the wrong ears on purpose. Scorpio moons love a mystery. Tonight it has arranged one, and it is ringing two phones.

reading: Around 10:20 am, your phone will ring from a number you do not know, and the caller will ask for someone named after a bird, a Robin or a Jay, and hang up before you can answer. Odd but harmless. The Tiger shrugs.

Then Nancy texts at 10:24: someone just called her asking for the same bird name. Don't even scream. Two phones, two towns, one confused stranger looking for a bird. Scorpio moons love a coincidence that feels like a wink. The rest of the day runs smoothly, so spend it lightly. [[The Star]] reversed is reminding you that hope works best when you stop guarding it.
joel.mission: Answer one call or message today with an unusually cheerful greeting, like you have been waiting all week for it.
joel.omen: A bird landing near you right after a phone call. It means the coincidence is done and luck is next.

reading: The Wood Rat was born for Scorpio days: everybody has a secret and you can see most of them. A coworker is planning a surprise, a neighbour is hiding a new puppy. You will keep all of it to yourself, smiling.

Then the phone rings at 10:22 and a stranger asks for a bird. You laugh. Two minutes later Joel tells you the same thing happened to him. DES, absolutely, no notes. Keep the ruby turned inward today and let the coincidence glow. It means the line between you is open and loud.
nancy.mission: Keep one delightful secret today, and drop exactly one cryptic hint about it before bed.
nancy.omen: A second wrong number later in the day. It means the universe is laughing with you, not at you.
nancy.stoneWhy: the line to Joel is open

together.text: ΔΕΣ. Somewhere out there a stranger is looking for a bird and dialled the two of you in a row. Together, invent who they were really trying to reach, why, and how it ends. It must end happily, with binoculars.

game.intro: Same wrong number, two phones. Don't even scream. The crew is dialling up three fast choices.
